title: Low-regularity Schrödinger map flow on high-dimensional periodic domains
summary: We study the initial-value problem for the Schrödinger map flow from flat torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ into compact Kähler manifold $\mathcal{N}$. When $d \geq 3$ and $\mathcal{N} = \mathbb{S}^2$, we establish local well-posedness in $H^σ_x$ with $σ> d/2 + 1/2$. In this case, the evolution equation for the gradient of the solution reduces to a certain semilinear nonlinear Schrödinger equation (also known as modified Schrödinger map flow) when formulated in orthonormal frames.
